correctness.rationale: The theta quadratic model is explicit and standard for smooth plane quartics in characteristic not two. Four odd vectors form a syzygetic tetrad exactly when their XOR is zero, by polarization. The 315 tetrads are exhaustively enumerated, and each four-vector incidence column obeys the mod-four total and six mod-two coordinate congruences. The augmented binary rank 7 proves the congruence homomorphism onto Z/4+(Z/2)^6 is surjective; its kernel has exact index 256. The specified lex-ordered 28-column incidence determinant is -256, independently recomputed with fraction-free integer Bareiss, implying lattice index at most 256. Sandwich equality establishes the full infinite integer span, hence Smith 1^21,2^6,4. The saved standalone verifier uses integer arithmetic only; the selected columns and ordering are specified in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: The 28-by-315 incidence lattice of syzygetic tetrads is intrinsic to the 28 bitangents of a smooth genus-three canonical curve, not an arbitrary numeric slice. The exact membership test solves the natural integral reconstruction problem for this classical bitangent/conic configuration. The six independent order-two and one order-four congruence obstructions are invisible from the known block counts and group action alone, and establish a complete integral invariant with a reproducible sharp certificate. No claim about Picard or Jacobian torsion is made.
